disposition_reason: Primary PDF found locally (not access-blocked). Table 3 prints per-sample Cd, Pb ('Pd'), Cu and As in 14 Apis dorsata honey samples by AAS with LOD 0.01 ppm; Cd detected in 3, Pb in 4, As in none.
disposition_locator: Table 3 (Physicochemical analysis of honey samples), p.131; Abstract p.123

study.material_scope: squeezed winter honey of Apis dorsata (rock bee); 5 unifloral (B. campestris x4, C. sativum x1), 9 multifloral per Table 2
study.growing_origin_vs_market: Collected from hives in rural (Kotwa, Phaphamau, Phoolpur, Handia) and urban (Company garden, Govindpur, Lukarganj, Naini, Teliyarganj) localities of Prayagraj District, Uttar Pradesh, India; not retail.
study.method: AAS (Perkin Elmer Analyst 700) in a certified laboratory, University of Allahabad; digestion procedure not reported
study.lod_loq: LOD 0.01 ppm (mg/kg) for Cd, Pb, Cu, As (Table 3 footnote); LOQ not reported
study.basis: Not stated; assumed as-is honey weight (mg/kg).
study.qa: Table 3 footnote: values mean ± SD, n=3 (metal cells printed without SD); no CRM or recovery.

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Summary raw_path points to raw/manual-fetch/seasonal-geographic-variance/auto-fetched/auto-mineral-water-tas-product_2020_10-35535-acpa-2020-0004.pdf, but no such file exists in auto-fetched/; identical copies (same sha256) are in .../ingested/ and .../skipped/skip_not-food-occurrence/.
Summary takes values from the abstract; Table 3 confirms them and also explicitly prints BLD for all other sample x metal cells (e.g. H13 Cd BLD), which the summary does not tabulate.
No numeric contradictions found for Cd/Pb/As.
unresolved: Lead is labelled 'Pd' in Table 3, abstract and text; interpreted as Pb from the Methods heavy-metal list (typographic error).
Digestion procedure and QA for metals not reported.
Text lists H8 as both unifloral and multifloral and omits H3/H12 from the multifloral list; floral type taken from Table 2 (H8 unifloral B. campestris).
Fe range in text (2.0-5.9 mg/kg) differs from abstract (2.0-4.8); Table 3 H10 Fe 5.9 supports the text (non-HMI analyte, noted only).
Cu (all BLD) not extracted because it is outside the analyte list.
